deep_dive.title: MPQ: A Message-Passing View of Post-Training Quantization
deep_dive.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a key technique for efficiently deploying large language models, as it compresses weights into low-bit representations without retraining. Existing PTQ solvers, including GPTQ, LDLQ, and block coordinate descent, commit each weight block to a single codeword before its neighbors are considered, leaving near-optimal alternatives unexplored. In this work, we cast row-wise PTQ as posterior inference over discrete codebooks, in which existing solvers correspond to a zero-temperature, hard-decision limit retaining only the top codeword per block. We propose Message-Passing Quantization (MPQ), which preserves soft posterior information across blocks during inference and commits to hard codewords only at the output stage. MPQ first uses vector approximate message passing to compute approximate blockwise posteriors, then refines a hard-decision initialization by exact block coordinate descent. Across 2-bit lattice and 3- and 4-bit scalar quantization on dense language models from Llama, Qwen, and Mistral families, MPQ improves perplexity and zero-shot accuracy over strong hard-decision baselines, and composes favorably with preprocessing techniques such as activation-aware scaling and incoherence processing. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/poseidonchan/MPQ.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Existing PTQ solvers such as GPTQ commit each weight block to one codeword too early. MPQ casts row-wise PTQ as posterior inference over codebooks, keeps soft messages across blocks, and hardens only at output, improving low-bit LLM accuracy.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 现有GPTQ等训练后量化方法在考虑相邻权重块之前就把每个块硬判决为单个码字，容易错过近优解。本文将逐行PTQ建模为离散码本上的后验推断，并提出消息传递量化MPQ，在推理过程中保留跨块的软后验信息，仅在输出阶段进行硬码字判决。该视角统一了GPTQ等求解器，并在低比特大语言模型量化中改善了精度与效率的权衡。

deep_dive.title: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization
deep_dive.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) to FP4 has emerged as a key technique for reducing large language model inference cost, especially on Blackwell GPUs, which offer native FP4 tensor core support. Direct PTQ to FP4, however, still leaves a noticeable accuracy gap. Recent work on SVDQuant mitigates the errors introduced through FP4 quantization for diffusion models by adding high-precision low-rank corrections obtained via SVD. However, this high-precision low-rank correction requires many bits per rank, and it runs on the same tensor cores as the main FP4 GEMM. We introduce BiLoCo, a low-rank correction method whose left and right factors are stored as binary ${\{\pm 1\}}$ sign vectors rather than as BF16 numbers. The signed format uses $16{\times}$ less storage per rank-one component, and since the correction now consists of additions/subtractions, this can be run on CUDA cores concurrently with the FP4 tensor-core GEMM. On 4B--72B LLMs, BiLoCo matches or improves memory-matched SVDQuant for PTQ. We implement BiLoCo on B300 as a fused single kernel, where the FP4 GEMM runs on tensor cores, the bit-packed correction on the CUDA cores of the same launch, and the two are combined in the GEMM epilogue. With batch size $1$, the fused kernel is at most $11\%$ slower than the FP4-only GEMM for every rank up to $512$. At rank $128$, it is at most $20\%$ slower up to batch size $8$.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_en: low-rank corrections combined with FP4 post-training quantization

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: FP4 PTQ leaves an accuracy gap; SVD-based low-rank corrections are expensive in bits. BiLoCo stores low-rank correction factors as binary sign vectors, cutting storage 16x while recovering accuracy for quantized LLMs.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 将大语言模型训练后量化到FP4可显著降低推理成本，但直接量化仍存在明显精度差距；现有基于SVD的高精度低秩修正虽能缓解误差，却需要每秩大量比特且占用主FP4矩阵乘的同一张量核。本文提出BiLoCo，将低秩修正的左右因子存为±1二值符号向量而非BF16，以更少存储表示量化误差补偿。实验表明该方法在保持FP4推理效率的同时有效缩小精度差距，体现了量化与低秩修正联合的高效适配思路。

quick_skim.title: AudioScorer: Learning Question-Aware Token Relevance for Large Audio Language Models
quick_skim.abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) reason over speech, environmental sounds, music, and other acoustic information. However, their audio encoders produce dense token sequences that make long-form audio costly to process. Existing audio pruning methods reduce this cost using heuristics such as attention, representation similarity, or temporal sampling, but do not explicitly learn which tokens are most useful for a given question. We propose AudioScorer, a lightweight model that scores audio tokens according to the user question. It is trained by distilling the ranking of audio tokens under the frozen LALM's answer-gradient saliency, together with downstream answer supervision. Compared with other pruning methods, AudioScorer achieves the best or tied-best result at 10% token retention on 7 of 10 semantic and acoustic tasks, including speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio-scene classification.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Dense audio token sequences make long-form audio costly for LALMs, and heuristic pruning ignores the question. AudioScorer is a lightweight scorer distilled from answer-gradient saliency plus answer supervision, outperforming other pruning methods at reduced token counts.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 大型音频语言模型为长音频产生稠密token序列，处理代价高昂，而现有剪枝方法依赖注意力、相似度或时间采样等启发式，未显式学习哪些token对当前问题有用。作者提出轻量评分器AudioScorer，通过蒸馏冻结模型在答案梯度下的token显著性排序并结合下游答案监督来训练。实验表明其剪枝效果优于其他方法，在减少token数量的同时保持或提升下游性能。该工作为多模态大模型的问题感知token压缩提供了可迁移思路。

quick_skim.title: Video-MemComp: Taylor-Guided Sensitivity-Aware Memory Management for Streaming Video Understanding
quick_skim.abstract: The rapid growth of video data has created an urgent need for efficient video understanding systems that can handle long and continuous visual inputs, posing significant challenges for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to severe memory bottlenecks. Moreover, existing compression methods often overlook the explosive accumulation of approximation errors. To address this issue, we propose Video-MemComp, a training-free and sensitivity-aware context management framework for memory-constrained streaming video understanding. Our method theoretically decomposes compression error into orthogonal local approximation error and layer-wise structural sensitivity via a first-order Taylor expansion. To minimize local approximation error, we perform token aggregation in a pre-RoPE safe zone with an attention-conserving logit bias, mitigating geometric distortions caused by RoPE rotations. To manage layer-wise structural sensitivity, we dynamically allocate the KV cache budget based on offline gradient priors and online context entropy, prioritizing high-sensitivity layers. Video-MemComp outperforms or achieves performance comparable to full-cache and state-of-the-art compression methods on benchmarks including MLVU, VideoMME, and EgoSchema. Notably, it improves the overall accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-3B from 62.3% to 64.1% while reducing the KV cache to an equivalent of 6,000 tokens per layer, saving over 90% of KV memory.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: sensitivity-aware video context compression for streaming video understanding

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对流式视频理解中多模态大模型面临严重内存瓶颈、且现有压缩方法忽视近似误差累积的问题，本文提出无需训练的敏感性感知上下文管理框架Video-MemComp。该方法利用一阶泰勒展开把压缩误差分解为局部近似误差与层级结构敏感性，并据此在内存受限场景中指导上下文压缩与管理。该工作为连续视频流的高效理解提供了可解释的误差控制思路，并强调压缩误差分解对内存管理的重要性。
